verdict.rationale: Empresa Online is an online company-incorporation service, a kind of product that could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only an interactive web flow: Cartão de Cidadão or Chave Móvel Digital authentication, form-generated pacts, digital signing within the platform, and MBWay or Multibanco payment. Nothing in the pack mentions any official command-line tool.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
